newsitem.title: FINLAND: RUUTUNELONEN WINS NEW FINNISH TV STATION -AGENCY.
newsitem.headline: RUUTUNELONEN WINS NEW FINNISH TV STATION -AGENCY.

text.p: The Ruutunelonen consortium, mainly owned by Sanoma Oy and the Erkko family's Helsinki Media, won the licence for a fourth national TV channel, the Finnish STT news agency said on Thursday.
Suomen Uutisradio, owned by MTV, Aamulehti and some media groups linked to political parties, won the licence for a national commercial radio station, it said.
The votes fell nine to four in favour of Ruutunelonen and eight to four in favour of Uutisradio respectively, it said.
A rival bid for the TV consession had been mounted by A4 media, a group of former journalists, in which Luxembourg-based Compagnie Luxembourgeoise de Telediffusion (CLT) holds a minority stake.
